    int to, rev;

};

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<ll> dist, potential;
    vector<int> prevv, preve;

    MinCostFlow(int nodes) : n(nodes) {
        graph.resize(n);
        dist.resize(n);
        potential.resize(n, 0);
        prevv.resize(n);
        preve.resize(n);
    }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, ll cap, ll cost) {
        graph[from].emplace_back(to, cap, cost, graph[to].size());
        graph[to].emplace_back(from, 0, -cost, graph[from].size() - 1);
    }

    pair<ll, ll> minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        ll flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (true) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            bool updated = true;
            while (updated) {
                updated = false;
                for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
                    if (dist[v] == INF) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < graph[v].size(); ++i) {
                        Edge &e = graph[v][i];
                        if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost + potential[v] - potential[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost + potential[v] - potential[e.to];

                            preve[e.to] = i;
                            updated = true;

                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;

            for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
                if (dist[v] < INF) {
                    potential[v] += dist[v];
                }
            }

            ll f = INF;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                f = min(f, graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            }
            flow += f;
            cost += f * (potential[t] - potential[s]);

            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge &e = graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= f;
                graph[v][e.rev].cap += f;
            }
        }
        return {flow, cost};
    }
